title: My first thread. Thank you and farewell

posts.author: Jokokit123
posts.body:
i never really had the chance to open my first thread so ill take it now while in its last moments..
i haven't really been on here for a long while but i made great connections and RPG maker XP is what pushed me to finally start working on my game and my dream, ill continue developing art, music, and code and keep the sweet people i met here in my mind always
may everyone lead fulfilling lives and may we meet in a different corner of the world sometime in the future, stay well everyone <3
